methodology: Client workload executes unique-key SET operations (and periodic GETs) at the configured aggregate rate through the controller, which forwards only to the current Raft leader. Faults are injected at ~30% of the run and removed at ~70%. Latencies are measured client-side around the full commit round trip. Raft safety properties are sampled every 0.5 s from live node logs and state machines. No numbers are simulated or post-processed.
